item: Row 325: a restore refused for a half-migrated corpus is named as such and asked before staging
summary: R788 (#2288) made a committing restore refuse a corpus a country-code migration left half done, but the volume restore journalled that refusal as the swap barrier (another job still held the corpus), sending the operator after a lease holder that did not exist, and both staging paths asked it only inside run_restore, after the backup had been verified, reassembled and decrypted. It now has its own storage-events reason (half-migrated: a country-code migration of the corpus did not finish, or its state could not be read) on the volume and the single-file restore, and both staging paths ask it before a byte is decrypted and before the writer-jobs check, which stops the jobs it may stop and starts them again only when it refuses itself.
